description: Gate generator built on a grid of sixteen cells, each dividing the incoming clock its own way, with eight outputs taking the rows and the columns of that grid

params.text: Puts the grid knobs on the division setting, where a cell fires a gate once every 1 to 64 clock ticks and a cell left at 0 stays silent
Puts the grid knobs on the step setting, where a cell set above 0 fires once per reset rather than repeating, that many of its divisions after the reset
Puts the grid knobs on the probability setting, from a cell that never fires to one that fires on every division
Puts the grid knobs on the speed setting, running a cell at a multiple of the clock from a quarter of it up to sixteen times it
Puts the grid knobs on the clock shift setting, holding a cell back by 0 to 64 whole clock ticks after each reset
Puts the grid knobs on the time shift setting, moving a cell up to a tick early or a tick late, which is how swing is set
Puts the grid knobs on the pulse width setting, from a gate of no length at all to one filling the whole division
Chooses which of the sixteen stored patterns is played and edited, 0 to 15, and the change takes effect at the next reset
Edits pattern A, which is what the four outputs marked A play while the grid is in independent mode
Edits pattern B, which is what the four outputs marked B play while the grid is in independent mode
Puts the grid on one shared pattern that feeds all eight outputs at once, the A outputs from its rows and the B outputs from its columns
Silences its own output; the lamp is green while that output plays and red while it is muted
Sets one value for that cell of the grid — its division, step, probability, speed, clock shift, time shift or pulse width, whichever page is selected; the cell's other six values are kept

inputs.text: The clock every cell counts its divisions from
A trigger here restarts every cell, so the clock shifts and step offsets are counted from here again, and it brings in the pattern the PTRN knob has been moved to
0V to 10V adds 0 to 15 to the pattern chosen by the PTRN knob
A trigger here switches the grid between the matrix pattern and the independent A and B patterns

outputs.text: 10V while any of the four cells in its row of the grid is firing, and in independent mode that row is read from pattern A
10V while any of the four cells in its column of the grid is firing, and in independent mode that column is read from pattern B

notes: the strip above the grid knobs reads out the value of the last knob touched, on whichever page is selected
every cell of the grid comes up at 0, which is silent, so no gates leave the outputs until cells are turned up on the division page

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
